column1: # partitions.csv -- the ACTIVE table (a copy of partitions_s3_16mb.csv).
# partitions_s3_16mb.csv -- custom 16 MB layout for the 16 MB S3 boards:
#   - ESP32-S3-Touch-LCD-1.47
#   - ESP32-S3-Touch-AMOLED-1.8   (same 16 MB flash; no board-specific changes)
# Total flash = 16 MB (0x1000000). Sizes are flash-size-driven
# so both boards share this table verbatim.
# OTA ENABLED: app0 and app1 are an ota_0/ota_1 PING-PONG PAIR. An update is
# written to whichever slot is NOT running
# bootable in otadata -- so a download that is corrupt
# leaves the running firmware untouched

column1: # Re-flashing a DIFFERENT partition table is DESTRUCTIVE. nvsext and ffat move
# so saved settings (Preferences) and everything on the FAT volume are lost --
# the data is still on the flash but no longer where the firmware looks. Back up
# anything on FFat first

column1: # This is a one-time cost: the whole point is that after this
# over the air and never need the cable again.
# CRITICAL -- fixed offsets (or BLACK SCREEN):
#   0x8000  partition table
#   0xe000  boot_app0.bin  -> otadata MUST be at 0xe000
#   0x10000 the app .bin   -> app0 MUST start at exactly 0x10000
# App partitions start on a 64 KB (0x10000) boundary. The head nvs stays 20 KB:
# it serves the SYSTEM consumers of the default "nvs" (WiFi PHY/cal
# bonds); the firmware's own Preferences live in "nvsext".
# Sizing: two 4 MB app slots (app ~1.9 MB -> ~2 MB headroom each)
